summary: Hero source image of Bit/Bot in the cowboy role, posed in a full-figure hero stance wearing a cowboy hat, neckerchief, and western accessories against a plain white background.

composition: Single full-figure hero pose against a plain white background.
Bit/Bot is centered, facing the viewer with a slight three-quarter turn.
Cowboy role costume and props are clearly visible and readable.
character_design: White and rounded robot head with large glowing eyes and a friendly smile.
Cowboy hat and tan or brown western accessories matching the cowboy column.
Wheeled base matching the Bit/Bot support-bot design.
Chest nameplate or badge indicating the cowboy role.
props_and_role_markers: Cowboy hat (western) as the primary role marker.
Neckerchief or bandana at the neck and cowboy-style boots.
Lasso or rope as a cowboy prop, coiled or held in the hero pose.
Brown and tan color accents on the hat, belt, and accessories.

positive_constraints: Use this image as the canonical cowboy hero reference for Bit/Bot.
Preserve the western hat, neckerchief, boots, and lasso or rope prop.
Keep the friendly, confident pose and neutral white background for source-image use.
Maintain the rounded white body, wheeled base, and simple face of Bit/Bot.
negative_constraints: Do not change the robot's core body shape, wheel base, or face style.
Do not use this single source image as final art acceptance without image QA.
Do not introduce additional story, environment, or characters not shown.

best_for: Prompting new cowboy hero images of Bit/Bot.
